A01.remediation: Deny by default. Verify ownership / role on every route that reads a user id. Centralise authorization in middleware.

A02.remediation: Use bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, sha-256+ for general hashing, HTTPS-only URLs, crypto.getRandomValues for tokens, and load secrets from a managed store.

A03.remediation: Use parameterised queries, never concatenate user input into SQL. Avoid eval / new Function. Sanitise HTML or use safe DOM APIs (textContent) instead of innerHTML.

A04.remediation: Apply per-IP and per-account rate limits on auth endpoints. Resolve security-related TODO/FIXME comments before shipping. Replace `as any` with a precise type or `unknown` plus a narrowing check — `any` silences the compiler exactly where untrusted data enters.

A05.remediation: Lock down CORS to explicit origins, disable debug in production, ship default-deny settings and helmet-style security headers.

A07.remediation: Use bcrypt/argon2 for password hashing, constant-time comparison, enforce MFA, and rotate any leaked signing keys.

A08.remediation: Verify JWT signatures, sign CI artefacts and lock down auto-update channels.

A09.remediation: Add structured logging on auth, authorization and data-modification events with user id, IP and timestamp.

A10.remediation: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs, resolve DNS yourself to block private/loopback addresses, and disable HTTP redirections on the HTTP client.

owaspRemediation.A01: Add per-route guards (`router.get('/user/:id', requireAuth, canReadUser, …)`). Use ownership checks (`if (resource.ownerId !== req.user.id) throw new Forbidden()`).
owaspRemediation.A02: Move secrets to env / vault. Use `crypto.getRandomValues` for tokens. Use `bcrypt` / `argon2` for passwords.
owaspRemediation.A03: Use parameterised queries (`db.query('… WHERE id = ?', [id])`). Replace eval / new Function with explicit dispatch. Use textContent over innerHTML.
owaspRemediation.A04: Add rate-limits to auth endpoints. Resolve security TODOs before shipping.
owaspRemediation.A05: Restrict CORS to known origins, disable debug in production, enable helmet() with default config.
owaspRemediation.A07: Compare passwords with bcrypt.compare. Pin JWT algorithms. Enforce MFA on sensitive accounts.
owaspRemediation.A08: Verify every JWT. Never disable signature verification. Sign CI artefacts.
owaspRemediation.A09: Use a structured logger (winston / pino) and log auth + admin events.
owaspRemediation.A10: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs. Resolve DNS yourself to block private IPs. Disable HTTP redirects on the HTTP client.

vulnerable: const row = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '${req.params.id}'`);
fixed: const row = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?', [req.params.id]);
